records.name: Tresenwart Feierabend
records.biography_en: Remembers every regular except the one who remembers his tab. He polishes HyperNorm glasses until every reflection agrees. A dissonant card keeps showing a regular who has not arrived yet. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Gast ist bekannt. Seine Zahlung ist neu.

variant_notes.note_en: Remembers every regular except the one who remembers his tab.

records.name: Mixologin Charleston
records.biography_en: Treats restraint as an ingredient best measured sparingly. Her shaker combines HyperNorm ingredients otherwise forbidden to share a category. A dissonant card orders the contradiction without ice. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Zurückhaltung wird tropfenweise untergehoben.

variant_notes.note_en: Treats restraint as an ingredient best measured sparingly.

records.name: Flaschenwart Freihand
records.biography_en: Is quite sure the difficult part happens after the catch. He holds two HyperNorm bottles labelled respectively correct and incorrect. A dissonant card asks why both smell of the same evening. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der schwierige Teil kommt nach dem sicheren Griff.

variant_notes.note_en: Is quite sure the difficult part happens after the catch.

records.name: Sirupmeister Ungefähr
records.biography_en: Knows the recipe precisely until someone asks what is in it. His HyperNorm recipe permits either sweet or bitter. A dissonant card asks for both and receives a surprisingly sympathetic garnish. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Rezept bleibt unter den Zutaten.

variant_notes.note_en: Knows the recipe precisely until someone asks what is in it.

records.name: Orbitalbarfrau Umlauf
records.biography_en: Has seen every orbit bring the same customer back. Her sealed glass circles HyperNorm's orbital bar without spilling a conclusion. A dissonant card requests an open-ended drink. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Umlauf ist geschlossen. Die Rechnung bleibt offen.

variant_notes.note_en: Has seen every orbit bring the same customer back.

records.name: Fermentwart Sternenrest
records.biography_en: Cannot decide whether the house special is ready or self-aware. His HyperNorm tap-cylinder contains three bubbles where the production sheet allows two. A dissonant card has begun taking their order. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Hausgetränk hat sich noch nicht vorgestellt.

variant_notes.note_en: Cannot decide whether the house special is ready or self-aware.
